title: 第十九章 见家长第二十章 给蒋南孙上眼药
content_zh:
【恭喜宿主，签到成功，获得权璟律所百分之二十股份。】
权璟律所百分之二十的股份？
即使是姜辰的心理素质再高，听到这系统提示音后，他就有些发愣。
权璟律所，不就是精英律师中的律师事务所吗？
“姜总？”余青青的声音响起。
“余青青是吧？”
姜辰回过神来，看着余青青说道：“你来公司应聘的是法务部的法务总监？”
“是的。”余青青点点头。
“按照资料，你从学校毕业没多久吧？你觉得你能够胜任公司的法务总监吗？”姜辰问道。
“我觉得我是可以的。”余青青回答道。
“现在法务部包括你在内只有五人，不过对公司来说，这些人远远不够。我会安排人事部尽快的招人的，在今年年底之前，法务部的人不少于十人。另外，你带着法务部多了解一下收购方面的情况。”姜辰说道。
“好的，姜总。”余青青对姜辰的纷纷并不意外，毕竟，星辰投资是投资公司。
“另外，在半个月后，我要去一趟燕京。到时候，我会去燕京的权璟律所，我想要你跟我一起去。”姜辰说道。
“权璟律所？九大律师事务所之一的权璟律所？”余青青震惊了。
作为一个律师，她怎么会不知道权璟律所？
当初在读大学的时候，她甚至在想，有朝一日如果能够进入权璟律所多好。但虽然她也是学霸级别的存在，但想要进入权璟律所的可能性太低了，再加上权璟律所在燕京，所以在找工作的时候，也没有选择权璟律所。
“对，我有权璟律所股权，到时候去权璟律所的时候，你跟他们好好的交流一番。”姜辰道。
“好的。”余青青心中的震惊难以掩饰。
姜辰竟然有权璟律所的股份，这意味着什么，她十分的明白，而且，对一个律师来说，能够和权璟律所的那些精英律师交流，就是千载难逢的机会。
余青青离开后，姜辰还在思考权璟律所的事。

余青青是他签到的第八个人。
也是第二次拥有其他公司的股份。
难道以后签到只能签到股份吗？
虽然股份也不错，但有时候技能比股份更重要。
同时，姜辰甚至在怀疑，他签到得到的东西，可能就是和这些女角色本身有关，不过，这只是他的猜测，无法证实。
这天，聂星辰交给了姜辰一份文件。
“姜总，这是我整理的互联网公司。”
“我看看。”
姜辰打开看了一眼，说道：“这是滴滴打车准备融资？”
“是的。”
聂星辰点点头，说道：“滴滴打车现在在准备D轮融资。”
“你去联系一下，看看我们能不能参加融资。”姜辰说道。
content_en:
[Congratulations to the host, you signed in successfully and obtained 20% of the shares of Quan Jing Law Firm. 】
Twenty percent of the shares of Quan Jing Law Firm?
No matter how high Jiang Chen's psychological quality was, he was in a daze after hearing the system prompt.
Isn’t Quan Jing Law Firm a law firm among elite lawyers?
"Mr. Jiang?" Yu Qingqing's voice sounded.
"Yu Qingqing, right?"
Jiang Chen came back to his senses, looked at Yu Qingqing and said, "You came to the company to apply for the legal director of the legal department?"
"Yes." Yu Qingqing nodded.
"According to the information, you graduated from school not long ago, right? Do you think you are qualified to be the company's legal director?" Jiang Chen asked.
"I think I can." Yu Qingqing replied.
"There are only five people in the legal department including you, but for the company, these people are far from enough. I will arrange for the personnel department to recruit people as soon as possible. Before the end of this year, there will be no less than ten people in the legal department. In addition, you can take the legal department to learn more about the acquisition." Jiang Chen said.
"Okay, Mr. Jiang." Yu Qingqing was not surprised by Jiang Chen's response. After all, Xingchen Investment is an investment company.
"In addition, in half a month, I am going to Yanjing. At that time, I will go to Quan Jing Law Firm in Yanjing, and I want you to go with me." Jiang Chen said.
"Quan Jing Law Firm? Quan Jing Law Firm, one of the nine major law firms?" Yu Qingqing was shocked.
As a lawyer, how could she not know about Quan Jing Law Firm?
When she was in college, she even thought about how great it would be to get into Quan Jing Law Firm one day. But although she is also a top student, the possibility of entering Quan Jing Law Firm is too low. In addition, Quan Jing Law Firm is located in Yanjing, so when looking for a job, she did not choose Quan Jing Law Firm.
"Yes, I have equity in Quanjing Law Firm. When you go to Quanjing Law Firm, you can have a good communication with them." Jiang Chen said.
"Okay." Yu Qingqing couldn't conceal the shock in her heart.
Jiang Chen actually owns shares in Quan Jing Law Firm. She understands very well what this means. Moreover, for a lawyer, being able to communicate with those elite lawyers at Quan Jing Law Firm is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
After Yu Qingqing left, Jiang Chen was still thinking about Quan Jing Law Firm.
Yu Qingqing is the eighth person he signed.
This is also the second time I own shares in other companies.
Will I only be able to sign in for shares in the future?
Although shares are also good, sometimes skills are more important than shares.
At the same time, Jiang Chen even suspected that the things he got after signing in might be related to the female characters themselves. However, this was just his guess and could not be confirmed.
On this day, Nie Xingchen handed Jiang Chen a document.
"Mr. Jiang, this is the Internet company I organized."
"Let me see."
Jiang Chen opened it and took a look and said, "Is this Didi Taxi preparing for financing?"
"Yes."
Nie Xingchen nodded and said: "Didi Dache is now preparing for D-round financing."
"Go get in touch and see if we can participate in financing." Jiang Chen said.
